paper.ref: Chen Z.-X. et al., Energy Storage Mater. 2025, 83, 104502
paper.group_note: E/S 12–4.5 系列只用一种弱溶剂化电解液（无 A vs B），不进表；跨电解液比较只有 LiFSI vs LiTFSI（同一弱溶剂化溶剂）

FSI.name: LiFSI 电解液
FSI.label: 弱溶剂化
FSI.quote: The LiFSI electrolyte was prepared using mixed solvents of DME/DOL/DIPS (1:0.75:0.25, molar ratio) with 0.8 mol L−1 LiFSI, 0.2 mol L−1 LiTFSI, and 5.0 wt.% LiNO3

TFSI.name: LiTFSI 电解液（弱溶剂化基准）
TFSI.label: 弱溶剂化
TFSI.quote: The LiTFSI electrolyte was prepared using mixed solvents of DME/DOL/DIPS (1:0.75:0.25, molar ratio) with 1.0 mol L−1 LiTFSI and 5.0 wt.% LiNO3

C1.desc: 扣式，4.0 mg/cm²、E/S 4.5、50 µm Li，倍率测试
C1.quote: lithium metal foils with a diameter of 15.0 mm and a thickness of 50 μm were adopted as the anode … 4.0 mgS cm−2 Li‒S cells with the LiFSI electrolyte or the LiTFSI electrolyte were assembled at the E/S ratio of 4.5 μL mg−1 and the rest configurations were kept the same

C2.desc: 扣式，4.0 mg/cm²、E/S 5、50 µm Li，0.2C 循环
C2.quote: To evaluate the long cycling performance, 4.0 mgS cm−2 Li‒S cells at the E/S ratio of 5 μL mg−1 were assembled … then galvanostatically cycled at 0.2 C between 1.70–2.60 V

C3.desc: 扣式，7.0 mg/cm²、E/S 5、50 µm Li，倍率后 0.1C
C3.quote: assembling Li‒S cells with the sulfur loading of 7.0 mgS cm−2. The LiFSI electrolyte or the LiTFSI electrolyte was used as the electrolyte, respectively. The E/S ratio was 5 μL mg−1

C4.desc: 3 Ah 软包，7.8 mg/cm²（单面）、E/S 2.8 g/g、75 µm Li
C4.quote: Five sulfur cathodes (7.8 mgS cm−2 on a single side) and six lithium anodes were stacked layer-by-layer … the E/S ratio was 2.8 gele gS−1 … The thickness of the lithium foil was 75 μm on a single side

C5.desc: 5 Ah 软包，7.9 mg/cm²（单面）、E/S 2.5 g/g、75 µm Li，0.05C
C5.quote: 5 Ah Li‒S pouch cells were assembled with nine sulfur cathodes (7.9 mgS cm−2 on a single side) and ten lithium anodes using PE separators and the E/S ratio was 2.5 gele gS−1. The 5 Ah pouch cells were discharged at 0.05 C

comparisons.author_judgement: LiFSI 加速界面电荷转移动力学
comparisons.reason_quote: Therefore, the LiFSI electro­ lyte successfully accelerates the interfacial charge transfer kinetics
comparisons.quote: the Li‒S cells deliver a high discharge capacity of 980 mAh g−1 at the current density of 0.1 C in the LiFSI electrolyte, which is 180 mAh g−1 higher than that in the LiTFSI electrolyte

comparisons.author_judgement: LiTFSI 克服不了 Li2S 成核阶段的大极化
comparisons.reason_quote: while the Li‒S cells fail to overcome the huge polarization at the Li2S nucleation stage in the LiTFSI electrolyte
comparisons.quote: The Li‒S cells with the LiFSI electrolyte cycle stably at 0.3 C (1 C = 1672 mA g−1) and deliver a high discharge capacity of 798 mAh g−1 (Fig. 4a, S36, and S37). Com­ paringly, the Li‒S cells with the LiTFSI electrolyte can only work at 0.1 C

comparisons.author_judgement: LiTFSI 在 0.2C 下立即失效
comparisons.reason_quote: The LiTFSI electrolyte can hardly guarantee smooth sulfur redox kinetics at high current density
comparisons.quote: the Li‒S cells with the LiFSI electrolyte achieve a high discharge capacity of 984 mAh g−1 at 0.2 C and cycle stably for 50 times … 578 mAh g−1 984 mAh g−1 0.2 C LiFSI LiTFSI

comparisons.point: 容量降到 60% 时的圈数
comparisons.quote: the Li‒S cells with the LiTFSI electrolyte fail immediately at 0.2 C. Comparingly, the Li‒S cells with the LiFSI electrolyte achieve a high discharge capacity of 984 mAh g−1 at 0.2 C and cycle stably for 50 times before the capacity reaches 60 % of the initial capacity
A maximum cycling rate of 0.25 C is achieved in the LiFSI electrolyte while the LiTFSI electrolyte only supports a maximum cycling rate of 0.15 C

When the cycling rate changes back to 0.1 C, 15 stable cycles are achieved with the help of the LiFSI electrolyte, while the weakly-solvating Li‒S cells with the LiTFSI electrolyte fail rapidly after only one cycle at 0.1 C

The Li‒S pouch cell with the LiFSI electrolyte delivers high discharge capacities of 1219, 1139, 1099, 1080, and 939 mAh g−1 at 0.025, 0.05, 0.08, 0.1, and 0.15 C … the Li‒S pouch cell with the LiTFSI electrolyte fails rapidly at 0.05 C
5 Ah Li‒S pouch cells with the LiFSI electrolyte were assembled and a high discharge capacity of 1150 mAh g−1 is delivered, which is 855 mAh g−1 higher than that in the LiTFSI electrolyte
